newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T up on U.S. tobacco ruling.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T up on U.S. tobacco ruling.

text.p: Shares in British tobacco to financial services group B.A.T Industries were marked higher in pre-market dealing on Friday as investors hailed a favourable U.S. court ruling for its U.S. unit Brown & Williamson.

B.A.T shares, which have lost over 20 percent this year, partly on worries about moves by smokers to seek compensation, were up 2-1/2p at 440p. Just over 120,000 shares had changed hands by 0717 GMT and the broader market was firm. A court in Louisville ruled on Thursday that a lawsuit against Brown & Williamson on behalf of a former smoker could not go forward.
Brown & Williamson said the judge agreed with its assertion that the risks associated with smoking were common knowledge and the manufacturer had no duty to issue a warning.
